items.exampleEn: The lawyer cited an old case to support her argument.
items.exampleZh: 律師引用了一個舊案例來支持她的論點。

items.exampleEn: Many shoppers prefer brands with ethical working conditions.
items.exampleZh: 許多消費者偏好工作條件合乎道德的品牌。

items.exampleEn: The building was designed for aesthetic reasons, not practical ones.
items.exampleZh: 這棟建築是為了美觀而設計的，不是為了實用。

items.exampleEn: Demographic changes mean the number of workers will drop in the future.
items.exampleZh: 人口結構的變化意味著未來勞動力會變少。

items.exampleEn: The wedding cake was very elaborate, with five layers.
items.exampleZh: 那個結婚蛋糕非常精緻，總共有五層。
items.glossZh: 精心的、複雜的；詳細說明

items.exampleEn: The city formulated new rules for street parking.
items.exampleZh: 市政府制定了新的路邊停車規則。

items.exampleEn: The scientist examined a specimen of rock from the moon.
items.exampleZh: 那位科學家檢查了一塊來自月球的岩石樣本。

items.exampleEn: My aunt is an anthropologist who writes about island music.
items.exampleZh: 我阿姨是人類學家，專門寫關於島嶼音樂的文章。

items.sentenceEn: Please cite at least three sources in your essay.
items.sentenceZh: 請在你的論文中至少引用三個出處。

items.audioEn: The anthropologist lived with the villagers for two years to study their customs.
items.audioZh: 那位人類學家和村民一起生活了兩年，研究他們的習俗。
items.questionZh: 這位人類學家做了什麼？
options: Built a school for the children

items.sentenceEn: Could you elaborate on your last point?
items.sentenceZh: 你可以詳細說明一下你最後一點嗎？

items.sentenceEn: The museum keeps rare plant specimens from all over the world.
items.sentenceZh: 這間博物館收藏著來自世界各地的稀有植物標本。

items.stemEn: Is it ____ for companies to collect so much personal information?
items.stemZh: 公司蒐集這麼多個人資料，合乎道德嗎？

items.stemEn: The team needs to ____ a clear plan before the meeting.
items.stemZh: 團隊需要在開會前擬定一個清楚的計畫。

items.passageEn: Professor Lin, an anthropologist at a university in Taipei, studies how young adults use public spaces. Her latest report focuses on one demographic: people aged twenty to thirty who live alone. Her team interviews people from a wide diversity of backgrounds. She found that many of them visit cafes not only for coffee but also for the aesthetic pleasure of a beautiful room. Other researchers often cite her work because her methods are careful and ethical: she always asks people for permission before recording anything. Next year, she plans to formulate new questions and elaborate on the role of libraries.
items.passageZh: 林教授是台北一所大學的人類學家，研究年輕人如何使用公共空間。她最新的報告聚焦在一個族群：二十到三十歲、獨自居住的人。她的團隊訪談了來自各種不同背景的人。她發現，他們很多人去咖啡館不只是為了咖啡，也是為了享受漂亮空間帶來的美感。其他研究者常常引用她的研究，因為她的方法嚴謹又合乎倫理：錄下任何東西之前，她一定會先徵求對方同意。明年，她打算擬定新的研究問題，並深入探討圖書館扮演的角色。

questions.questionZh: 林教授最新的報告聚焦在哪一群人？
options: 二十到三十歲獨居的年輕人

questions.questionZh: 其他研究者為什麼常引用她的研究？
options: 她的方法嚴謹且合乎倫理

items.promptZh: 這間公司有嚴格的道德規範。
referenceEn: This company has strict ethical rules.
The company follows strict ethical standards.
rubricZh: ethical 表示「道德的、合乎倫理的」（例如 ethical rules、ethical standards 等）

items.promptZh: 這位作家為她的小說設計了一個複雜的地下城市。
referenceEn: The writer created an elaborate underground city for her novel.
For her novel, the writer designed an elaborate underground city.
rubricZh: 「複雜的、精心的」用 elaborate（例如 an elaborate underground city 等）
「設計了」可寫，例如 created、designed、invented 等
